cookbooks.title: Getting Started with Portkey AI Gateway + Valkey
cookbooks.h1: Getting Started with Portkey AI Gateway + Valkey
cookbooks.lead: Configure the Portkey AI Gateway to use Valkey as its persistent LLM response cache via the portkey-ai SDK. Replace the default in-memory cache with a shared cache that survives restarts and scales across gateway instances.

cookbooks.title: Vector Search
cookbooks.lead: Use the gateway's valkey-search provider to create HNSW indexes, upsert documents with embeddings, and run KNN similarity queries - all through a unified REST API backed by Valkey.

cookbooks.title: Production with ElastiCache
cookbooks.lead: Connect the gateway to Amazon ElastiCache for Valkey with TLS, cluster mode, authentication, tuned cache TTLs, and HNSW parameters for production vector workloads.
